title: Communications and Marketing Manager
description:
Communications and Marketing Manager

Location: High Wycombe campus with travel to other sites as required.
Department: Central Services
Contract type: Permanent
Hours: Full-time
Salary: Grade G, salary range £39,014 to £43,740 per annum

Closing date for applications: Tuesday 25th August 2026 at midnight.
Interview date: Throughout application period.
Start date: October 2026.

At Bucks Students' Union, the 4th best Students' Union in the UK, we're looking for a creative, dynamic and highly organised professional to lead the way we communicate with our members, partners and stakeholders.

You'll be responsible for developing engaging, accessible and consistent communications that bring our brand to life across digital and print channels, ensuring every interaction reflects the Union's identity and values.

With a keen eye for detail and a strong understanding of branding, you'll produce high-quality marketing materials, oversee print production, monitor emerging student trends and use insight and feedback to ensure our communications remain relevant, inclusive and impactful.

Working collaboratively across the organisation, you'll inspire colleagues to promote their services effectively while identifying opportunities to grow awareness, engagement and income beyond our core trading activities.

You'll be tenacious in exploring new commercial opportunities, developing campaigns that strengthen our reputation and support the Union's long-term sustainability.

If you're passionate about creating meaningful connections with students, thrive in a fast-paced environment and combine creativity with excellent organisation and attention to detail, we'd love to hear from you.

Bucks Students' Union is a democratic, student-led organisation whose mission is to make life better for students at Bucks. We are committed to improving the student experience and actively seek to bring positive change to student life.

Not only are we ranked in the top 5 students' unions in the UK for the tenth consecutive year, we are a Mindful Employer and have achieved the highest standards in accreditation for Fairtrade, Green Impact, Best Bar None and Quality Students' Unions.

Our reward package provides over 40 days paid annual leave each year as well as a competitive pension, extensive development opportunities, wellbeing support and discount schemes, amongst other benefits.

We are committed to tackling inequality and offer a 'guaranteed interview scheme' for applicants of colour and/or applicants with a disability.

If you have a disability and/or are a person of colour and you meet the criteria of a role description and person specification of a role, please select the 'guaranteed interview scheme' option on the application form.

To Apply:

If you have the skills and experience we require for this role and are looking for a new challenge please click on APPLY to be considered.

We will be in touch should we wish to take your application forward in the recruitment process.

No agencies please.

title: Marketing & Events Executive
description:
Are you a marketing professional who enjoys creating engaging campaigns, promotions, and events that deliver measurable commercial results?

Do you thrive in a fast-paced, multi-site environment where you can build strong relationships with operational teams, manage multiple projects, and bring fresh marketing ideas to life?

Are you passionate about using customer insights, data, and a mix of marketing channels to increase engagement, drive footfall, and enhance customer experiences?

If you can answer yes to the above questions, then this could be the PERFECT role for you!

Reed Marketing & Creative are currently working with a leading business that is looking to recruit an experienced Marketing & Events Executive to join its growing team. This is an exciting opportunity for a commercially minded marketer to take ownership of promotional and event marketing activity across a portfolio of venues, supporting business growth through creative campaigns, customer engagement initiatives, and local marketing activations.

Key Responsibilities:
- Deliver engaging marketing campaigns, promotions, and events across multiple venues.
- Work closely with venue teams to identify local marketing opportunities and drive performance.
- Manage campaign schedules and promotional activity to ensure timely delivery.
- Create and coordinate marketing content across a range of channels.
- Execute customer communications through email, SMS, and other engagement platforms.
- Monitor campaign performance and use insights to improve future activity.
- Research competitor activity and identify new marketing opportunities.
- Support advertising, promotional partnerships, and local marketing initiatives.
- Manage campaign budgets and ensure strong return on investment.
- Act as a key marketing contact for operational stakeholders and support wider business projects.

The Successful Candidate Will:
- Have experience in a marketing, campaigns, events, or customer engagement role.
- Be confident managing multiple projects and competing deadlines.
- Have experience delivering multi-channel marketing campaigns.
- Possess strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Be highly organised with excellent attention to detail.
- Have a commercial mindset and be comfortable working with campaign data and results.
- Demonstrate creativity, initiative, and a proactive approach to work.
- Be proficient in Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
- Enjoy collaborating with colleagues while working independently when required.
- Hold a full driving licence and be willing to travel regularly.

In Return You Will Receive:

A competitive salary of £30,000 - £35,000 DOE, hybrid working, performance-related bonus opportunities, company laptop and mobile phone, and the opportunity to join a successful national business where you can make a genuine impact through creative marketing campaigns, events, and customer engagement initiatives. The role will involve regular regional travel with occasional overnight stays.

If you are keen to know more about this fantastic opportunity as a Marketing & Events Executive, please click on the link to apply! Alternatively, you can get in touch with Bianca Halliburton at Reed Marketing & Creative in Reading.

title: Marketing Automation Manager
description:
Marketing Automation & HubSpot Specialist

Milton Keynes Hybrid
£45,000 - £50,000

We're working with a growing B2 B business in Milton Keynes looking for a Marketing Automation & HubSpot Specialist to take ownership of HubSpot, automation and lead nurture.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys improving how marketing technology works, building smarter customer journeys and helping turn marketing engagement into genuine sales opportunities.

What you'll be doing
- Taking ownership of HubSpot Marketing Hub
- Building and optimising automated workflows and nurture journeys
- Managing lead scoring, segmentation and lifecycle stages
- Creating targeted email campaigns
- Improving MQL to SQL conversion alongside Sales
- Building dashboards to track campaign performance, pipeline and attribution
- Managing landing pages, forms and lead capture processes
- Maintaining CRM data quality
- Exploring how AI and automation can improve marketing performance

What we're looking for
- Hands-on HubSpot experience
- Experience with marketing automation, email and nurture campaigns
- Understanding of B2 B lead generation and sales funnels
- Confident with reporting, data and campaign analysis
- Experience with lead scoring, segmentation and CRM management
- Comfortable working closely with both Marketing and Sales

Experience within B2 B technology, SaaS or professional services would be beneficial but isn't essential.

This is a great opportunity to take real ownership of HubSpot and help shape how a growing business uses marketing automation to generate and convert more opportunities.
